name: LCM parallel geometric median
plain: Runs several noisy copies at the same sigma and merges their x0 predictions with a geometric median. A robust aggregate for one step, at K model calls per step.
math: For K noises: x_k=noise_scaling(σᵢ,n_k,x0). x0_k=model(x_k,σᵢ). x0=geomedian(x0_k) with up to 100 iterations. n_k=(x_k−x0)/σᵢ for next step.
label: from code
surprise: It uses noise_list from the previous residuals, so noise is recomputed rather than resampled unless consistent_noise is off.
